[BUG - MINOR] Missing router skill files for multimedia agents

The loader.py maps image/sound/video to router types but no corresponding files exist in studio/skills/_routers/. Missing: image.md, sound.md, video.md. Agents will work but won't receive router context that other agents get.

[WHAT] Design CLAUDE agent - vanilla passthrough [CONTEXT] Empty context agent for testing raw Claude CLI vs studio-augmented responses. Used to measure context injection value. [CONSTRAINTS] Minimal config - no custom role, no skills, no tools. Execute with all permissions. Agent name: claude.
[WHAT] Implement CLAUDE agent [CONTEXT] Create bare-bones agent folder per Taxonomy design. [CONSTRAINTS] studio/agents/claude/ - minimal files, no restrictions, passthrough mode.
[WHAT] QA review CLAUDE agent [CONTEXT] Verify implementation matches 'empty context' intent. [CONSTRAINTS] Should have no custom context injection. Confirm passthrough behavior.

[BUG - MAJOR] CLAUDE agent receives shared skills despite vanilla flag

Steps:
1. Send task to CLAUDE agent
2. Observe agent.py _build_system_prompt()
3. Shared skills from studio/agents/shared/*.md are still loaded

Expected: vanilla=true agents should skip all skill injection
Actual: Only router is skipped; shared skills, core tool skills, and context injection still occur

Location: studio/agent.py lines 62-81, 126-147

Suggested fix: Check config.get('vanilla', False) in StudioAgent.__init__ and skip skill loading if true

[BUG - MINOR] CLAUDE agent gets core tool skills injected

Steps:
1. Check CLAUDE agent initialization
2. _get_core_tool_skills() returns files.md, context.md, skills.md for non-boss agents

Expected: Vanilla agent should have no tool skills loaded
Actual: Core tool skills are injected via _build_system_prompt

Location: studio/agent.py:126-147

Note: Part of same root cause as shared skills bug - vanilla flag not checked
